rule_model_provenance.reason: All recorded games and sampled continuations used an underpowered Mining Road. Neither the comparative win rates nor the local decision gains validate the corrected rules.
rule_model_provenance.reproduction: The commands in this archive reproduce the historical inputs only when run at the historical engine commit. Current code uses corrected rules and distinct menu identities; collect new checkpoints and rerun before making strategy claims.

metric: Win share, with ties worth half; paired 95% intervals use one observation per seat-swapped seed pair.
selection_notes: The ten-way tournament narrowly favored the two-Highwayman Spice Merchant/Lost City engine by panel average.
A separate four-policy comparison selected the one-Highwayman Banquet opening before the initial validation.
Initial validation identified a small advantage for buying Tea House directly at $5 while retaining Banquet below $5.
That revised opening was frozen before the final validation on seeds starting at 3000000.
